messages:
pd-bot: PagerDuty: Triggered urgent_page for service: api-prod-ingress (high) — https://pagerduty.com/incidents/PD12345
ops-oncall: acked via pd mobile. getting the alert text now.
sam: seeing pages to infra oncall, not API oncall? @ops-oncall can you confirm who got paged?
ops-oncall: I was paged (infra rotation) but payload says api-prod-ingress, odd.
nora: I just checked PD — the incident is scoped to service api-prod-ingress but the escalation policy has a shadow binding to infra-team-schedule. looks like a schedule override slipped in during rotation swap.
mike: confirm — we had a temporary override for datacenter migration yesterday, maybe it was never removed.
ops-oncall: customers reporting elevated 502 rate; metrics: 5xx spike at 02:12 UTC, error rate ~6% on ingress. Linking Grafana: https://grafana.internal/d/abc/ingress-metrics
sam: can we mute the infra oncall and re-route to the correct API oncall? need to stop noisy pages.
elaine: temporary mitigation: placing maintenance window on the wrong schedule won't help. we should change the incident's service routing or update escalation target. I'll attempt to change PD binding.
ops-oncall: quick note — I'm handling initial triage (resp headers, recent deploys). no deploys in last 24h.
sre-bot: alert: ingress_502_rate > 4% for 5m (triggered at 02:12 UTC)
nora: @elaine go ahead with PD change, but also create a suppression rule so downstream dup pages stop.
elaine: running pd CLI: 
```
pd schedules override remove --id SCHED-MIGRATION-OVERRIDE
pd service update --id api-prod-ingress --escalation_policy EP-API-POLICY
pd maintenance_window create --service api-prod-ingress --duration 60 --description "temp suppression while routing fixed"
```
ops-oncall: ack from me cleared duplicates in Slack, but PD still escalated once to infra — they didn't need to get paged.
mike: digging into ingress logs — upstream auth service returning 502s intermittently; retry storms visible. opening a short playbook run.
sam: customer impact assessment: confirmed impacting a subset of customers behind us-west LB, ~1200 requests/min correlated, estimate ~15% of traffic in that window. Potentially user-facing 502s for 02:12—02:30 UTC.
ops-oncall: I've added a responder handoff: tagging @mike for remediation, @nora for routing fix, @sam for comms.
ora: routing change applied in PD — removed shadow binding, pinned escalation policy to EP-API-POLICY. please verify no more infra pages.
pd-bot: PagerDuty: Escalation policy updated for service api-prod-ingress (EP-API-POLICY).
sre-bot: monitoring: 502 rate back to baseline (0.7%) at 02:28 UTC.
ops-oncall: closing immediate paging loop. created incident ticket PD12345 and linked internal incident: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-9876
elaine: leaving a note in PD: temporary override removed, maintenance window created for 60m to suppress followups while we validate routing.
mike: root-cause look: backend auth had a connection pool exhaustion after a config change. rolling restart of auth instances reduced error rate.
sam: customer-impact summary for postmortem: 02:12—02:28 UTC, ~16 minutes, localized to us-west, approx 1.2k rps affected, 502s visible to end-users.
ops-oncall: post-incident action items: 1) ensure migration override removal is verified in runbook (owner: nora) 2) add PD schedule gating on overrides (owner: elaine) 3) improve Slack binding checks (owner: sam) 4) run a replay test of PD schedule to catch misroutes (owner: Mike).
nora: noted, will add to runbook and follow up with ops.
elaine: filing a PD support ticket to audit recent schedule overrides.
sam: thanks everyone. once PD incident state is resolved, let's sync for a short 15m postmortem. I'll draft impact blurb for customer comms. :thumbsup:
ops-oncall: incident resolved, marking as mitigated in PD.
pd-bot: PagerDuty: Incident PD12345 status changed to mitigated (02:35 UTC)
